block.description: The `qrcode` provider allows you to generate QR codes from input strings. This can be useful for encoding configuration details, authentication keys, or any other data in a scannable format. QR codes can be generated in PNG or ASCII formats, making it easy to integrate into various workflows.

file.description: Path to save the generated QR code image.

sensitive_text.description: Sensitive text content to encode in the QR code.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the generated QR code image.

size.description: Size of the QR code image in pixels.

text.description: The text content to encode in the QR code.

block.description: The `qrcode_generate` resource allows you to create QR codes from text input. This is useful for encoding information such as URLs, authentication keys, or configuration details into a scannable format. The QR codes can be generated in PNG format and saved to a specified file path, or displayed in ASCII format for terminal-based use.

ascii.description: ASCII text representation of the QR code.

ascii_sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the ASCII QR code.

disable_border.description: Set to true to disable the QR Code border.

error_correction.description: Error correction level: L (low), M (medium, default), Q (high), H (highest).

invert.description: Set to true to invert black and white colors.

sensitive_text.description: Sensitive text to encode as a QR code.

text.description: The text to encode as a QR code.

block.description: The `qrcode_generate` data source allows you to generate QR codes from text input without creating a file. This is useful for dynamically generating QR codes in ASCII format for display in logs, terminal outputs, or other text-based interfaces. It also supports various customization options, such as error correction levels, color inversion, and border removal.
